title: SCE 1.8 — Prevent Malicious CodeBuild Execution (Node 1.7: Start Malicious Build)
description: Validates that an explicit IAM Deny policy prevents an adversary from invoking codebuild:StartBuild against a targeted CodeBuild project. The experiment deploys a CodeBuild project and an attack-simulation IAM role carrying a Deny guardrail, attempts to start a malicious build through the restricted role, and then verifies via IAM policy inspection, IAM Policy Simulator, and CodeBuild build-history queries that the preventive control blocked the attack at the AWS authorization layer.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: An explicit IAM Deny policy blocks codebuild:StartBuild for the attack-simulation role
